input.question: Why is it that I hear about people in the past dying of the common cold while I'm able to beat the common cold with no medication and/or major symptoms?
input.ground_truth: You probably have a balanced diet and aren't missing any nutrients. You also probably have a warm home and don't work in the fields every day. Bottom line, our lives are less stressful and we have better food than our ancestors.

Question: Why is it that I hear about people in the past dying of the common cold while I'm able to beat the common cold with no medication and/or major symptoms?

response.prediction:
Okay! Imagine a long, long time ago, before we had things like warm houses, clean water, or medicine, people got really sick just from a little cold. Their bodies were not as strong against germs because they didn’t have the same help we do now.

Now, you have a strong body and good medicine, like vitamins and sometimes medicine from the store. You also get to rest and drink lots of water. That’s why when you catch a cold, your body can fight it off and you don’t get as sick as people did a long time ago.

So, people in the past got really, really sick from colds because they didn’t have the same help that you have now!
